div.head: VIII Atr 9
div.ab: And sy ælc geoguðe teoðung gelæst be pentecosten be wite;
And sy ælc geoguðe teoðung gelæst be pentecosten be wite,
And sy ælc geoguðe teoðung gelæst be Pentecosten be wite.
Und jeder Zehnt von Jungvieh werde zu Pfingsten entrichtet, bei Strafgeld
And let every tithe of young stock be paid by Pentecost, on pain of a fine,
And every tithe of young livestock shall be rendered by Pentecost, under pain of incurring the fine,
And each tithe of the young animals is to be paid by Pentecost or there will be a penalty.
div.note: Liebermann compares II Eg 3.; AZ: added from Rabin p. 194 / 195, October 2026 (Rabin’s note to the translation)
9–13: On the dues listed in these clauses, see the notes to The Laws of Edward and Guthrum 6.1–6.3, Canons 54, and 5 Æthelred 12.

note.seg: Cf. II Edg. 3; V Atr. 11, 1; VI, 17; I Cn. 8, 1; Wulfstan, p. 116 etc.; Can. Edg. 54, ed. Thorpe, op. cit. ii. p. 256.
